# Improved Dotted Name Search Vector Indexing

This migration updates the search_vector column in the entities table to better support searching for individual dotted-name segments by adding a version of the name with dots replaced by spaces into the text being indexed. This improves the ability to find segments like 'mod' within 'pkg.mod' during full-text search, addressing cases where such tokens would previously not be searchable.
